title: Evaluate structured self-audit and independent review effectiveness

preflight.note: Operator authorized the separate proposed research item as part of WI079 disposition. Existing prospective protocol is preserved; this registration authorizes no experiment, fixture execution, paid model calls, service, or spend.

acceptance_criteria.text: Before experimental execution, obtain explicit operator authorization and resource ceilings; preregister and freeze twelve matched task fixtures, golden tests, independent adjudication rubric, model/version, prompts, tools, budgets, seeds and condition order under the preserved WI079 protocol. Record any prospective amendment without rewriting the original protocol.

Run matched ordinary verification, bounded structured self-audit, and fresh-context independent-review conditions on the fixed tasks. Preserve raw candidates, actual tool invocations and outcomes; report skipped, unavailable, aborted and inconclusive trials without fabricated passes.

Measure escaped seeded defects with denominators, false findings on clean controls, regressions, task success, unnecessary churn, latency, tokens and observable cost. Preserve missing data as not measured; independently adjudicate and compare conditions with low-power limitations.

Publish a durable internal analysis with the complete result/evidence manifest, adverse and null outcomes, and appropriately qualified claims. Do not infer that structural self-report freshness replaces independent review or provides protected enforcement.

Reconcile the results with WI079's optional design and adjacent H14/WI044 questions. Record whether further research or a separately authorized protected policy is justified; do not change enforcement or publication status automatically. Complete only with concrete linked evidence and resolved documentation impact.
